actual_animation_kind: Complete procedural setupAnim, no external keyframe asset required; unused ModelAnimator constructed but never updated. Not missing-animation HOLD; independent applicability remains HOLD0.

body.hierarchy: 17 named parts; root -> body -> wings/left-right leg groups/tail/head; head -> paired antennae/mouth. Wings/legs/antennae are planes, not cuboid solid rectangles. Tail and mouth cuboids. Body 6x6x6, head4x4x4, abdomen4x4x16; declared128x128.
body.attachment: Natural mouth child of head; mount attachment is actor rideTick radius1 using host yBodyRot and quarter-eye height, not animated mouth-bone transform. No lamp/helditem objects designed or edited.

actual_facing_retreat_consumer: FlyAwayFromTarget MOVE canUse flying, not passenger, target nonnull, blood>0 OR drinkTime<0, no fleeing ID. canContinue target nonnull and blood/cooldown and flying and no horizontalCollision; it omits fleeing ID/passenger/alive checks present or implied elsewhere.

shootPos picked radius4..8 around target with target.yHeadRot+90+random0..179, targetY+1; require actor distance squared>30 and unobstructed point, else own block position. This is an orbit/reposition sample, not guaranteed monotonic increasing target distance.

tick sets MoveControl wanted position to shootPos at1.0 and lookAt target30. Controller MOVE_TO adds normalized displacement*speed*.05 to velocity. WITH target it sets actor YRot and yBodyRot directly from targetXZ, WITHOUT target from velocity. Actual displacement-vs-facing separation exists while moving toward retreat point; not dependent on skeletal head animation.

At point closer than2.5 squared, sets shooting state if cooldown0 and blood>0, then clears shootPos to choose another. stop only spitCooldown=20, leaves shootPos/wanted operation/velocity/flying/SHOOTING. FlyTowardsTarget.stop empty, RandomFlyGoal.stop targetnull only.

Arrival below AABB size switches WAIT and halves full velocity. WAIT while flying does not explicitly zero old velocity or movement input. Flyingfalse branch explicitly WAIT/speed0/Zza0/Xxa0 but does not explicitly clear deltaMovement.

Flying STRAFE branch computes vertical desired acceleration with unguarded length division, forces forwards1/right0 regardless requested strafe input, then WAIT. Therefore native strafe(-1,...) cannot be assumed supported by this custom flight controller.

Server tick toggles noGravity from isFlying BEFORE later repellent/lure/takeoff flying flag writes; flag transition can lag gravity update one tick. Passenger first sets flyingfalse. No custom hurt/death cancellation of all flight state shown.

After flightTicks>200 and no valid living target, landing branch calls getDeltaMovement().add(0,-.2,0) WITHOUT assigning returned vector; do not describe this as successful descent force. Only onGround sets flyingfalse and negative flightTicks.

Repellent flee is different: sets target/lastHurtBy null, unmounts, samples away point, then drives MOVE_TO. Target-null controller faces velocity, not original threat. Do not treat repellent flee as continuous target-facing retreat.

RandomFlyGoal continue omits target/lure/repellent checks from canUse; tick-level direct controller writes from repellent/lure and goals may overlap. Native scheduler not read, so final arbitration remains unproven.
actual_animation_and_recovery: flyProgress and shootProgress rise/fall one per tick0..5 from synchronized flags; model resets pose each setupAnim, reads partial interpolation. Entity assigns prevFlyProgress=flyProgress and prevShootProgress=shootProgress at END of tick, unlike true previous-before-update capture; no smooth interpolation promise.

Flight: bodyY -10 scaled progress/5, six planar legs yaw spread and Z±60, bodybob speed.25 degree2.5, wingsflap1.65/.5, leg flaps.5/.25, tailwalk.5/.075. Antenna walk always. Ground wings X30/Y±70 if neither flight progress nor randomwingflaptimer.

Shooting: setupShooting sets synchronizedSHOOTINGtrue and shootingTicks5. Model headX-10 and mouthX-20 scaled progress/5; mouthscale(1+.1p,1-.1p,1+.1p), so firing organ pulses rather than whole body waving.

Server countdown on5th update attempts spit only targetnonnull/blood>0, then SHOOTINGfalse; spit rejects sick. No alive/LOS recheck in own countdown. Server timer and client visual flag progression not an exact same-epoch contact receipt; target loss skips emission but does not cancel visual until countdown completes.

Passenger: bodyX-90/Y180, headX+40, mouthX+10, legZ±50 and mouthY pulsing .85+.15sin(age). Nonpassenger explicitly resets mouthscale1; later shooting overrides scale whenprogress>0. Tail explicitly sets scale1+.1blood each frame and subtracts blood*.05 from X. Pose and scale exits exist in this model, distinct from actor-motion cleanup.

No head faceTarget/netHeadYaw/headPitch use in model. Attention comes from controller actor facing and native look/render pipeline, not independent animated eye/head gaze. No own authored hurt/death clip. No model-view playback performed.
riding_lifecycle: rideTick zeros velocity before tick, copies host yaw/body/head and repositions. Every20 drinkTime ticks server damageattempt and acceptedhurt increases blood; full blood>3 or drinkTime>81 removes vehicle, flyingfalse/flightTicks-15. Else nonpassenger entitytick always resets drinkTime0, so negative drink cooldown not guaranteed persistent while unmounted. Packets/native riding internals not reviewed, no networking correctness claim.
renderer: 1.2*interpolatedMosquitoScale; sick/flee renderer shake; normal/sick and fromfly select four PNGs, blood>0 uses eyes layer. PNG contents not viewed in this batch; historical atlas study not current visual QA.

negative_controls.hover_backward_monotonic: NOT PROVEN: sampled orbital point can change distance; no required zero-speed hover.
negative_controls.actor_faces_target_during_MOVE_TO: FOUND explicit XZ target yaw consumer, bounded to MOVE_TO not WAIT and not repellent-null branch.
negative_controls.complete_exit: NOT FOUND own stops do not clear motion/path/flying/shooting and no inherited proof.
negative_controls.landing_acceleration: UNASSIGNED add result, cannot claim downward force from that expression.
